{{Infobox_character|Faction = Decepticon|Class = [[Demolitions]]|image = File:Ramjet featured.png|Origin = Generation 1|Release Date = September 21, 2017}} ==Bio== ''One of Starscream’s most unpredictable Seekers, Ramjet takes hardheadedness to new extremes by smashing into any foes, and sometimes friends, that cross his flight path.'' ==Story== ==Max Stats== '''2-Star''' *Health: 1,854 *Attack: 147 *Max Rating: 554 '''3-Star''' *Health: 4,553 *Attack: 309 *Max Rating: 1300 '''4-Star''' *Health: 11,834 *Attack: 802 *Max Rating: 3436 5-Star * Health: 28,730 * Attack: 1,946 * Rating: 8,325 {| class="article-table" !Rank/Level !Health !Attack !Rating |- |1/1 |6,360 |431 |1,476 |- |1/10 |10,031 |680 |2,323 |- |2/20 |13,066 |885 |3,085 |- |3/30 |16,997 |1,151 |4,102 |- |4/40 |22,093 |1,497 |5,518 |- |5/50 |28,730 |1,946 |8,325 |} ==Game Abilities== ===Basic Abilities=== * [[Stun]] * [[Burn]] * [[Unstoppable]] ===Abilities=== *''Passive:'' This bot's naturally tough Cybertronian exterior provides a permanent 10% passive Armor Buff. *Ram with ''Heavy Attacks:'' ** Shrugs off the impact of enemy attacks. ** 100% chance to Stun Burning opponents for 3 seconds.
{| class="article-table" !Rank !Special 1 Burn chance/% !Special 2 Burn !Special 2 Stun chance |- |1 |40%/30% |50% |72% |- |2 |45%/33% |55% |74% |- |3 |50%/35% |60% |76% |- |4 |55%/38% |65% |78% |- |5 |60%/40% |70% |80% |- |6 |65%/50% |80% |82% |} ===Signature Ability=== '''Momentum''' ''Ramjet builds momentum after ramming opponents.'' * Ramjet has a 50% chance to gain a permanent Special Bonus Buff that increases Special Attack Damage by 2~10% each. The chance to gain the Buff increases by 5% for each Special Bonus Buff already on him. [Max 10 Buffs] Stuns on himself expire 10% faster for each active Special Bonus Buff. * +0.02% per level {| class="article-table" !Level !Special Damage |- |5 |5% |- |10 |5.1% |- |15 |5.2% |- |20 |5.3% |- |25 |5.5% |- |30 |5.7% |- |35 |6.1% |- |40 |6.1% |- |45 |6.3% |- |50 |6.6% |- |55 |6.9% |- |60 |7.1% |- |65 |7.5% |- |70 |7.8% |- |75 |8.1% |- |80 |8.5% |- |85 |8.8% |- |90 |9.2% |- |95 |9.6% |- |100 |10% |} ===Special Attacks=== #'''Missile Volley''' - ''Ramjet unleashes a barrage of rockets from his chest.'' #* 40~60% Chance per hit to inflict up to four Burns that deal 20~35% attack as heat damage over 5 6 seconds. #'''Rocket Blaster''' - ''A blast of heat followed by a sudden impact is guaranteed to leave an opponent dizzy.'' #* 100% Chance per hit to inflict Burn, dealing 50~70% attack as heat damage over 6 seconds. #* 72~80% Chance to cause Stun for 3.5 seconds. #''' Dive Bomb''' - ''You can run but you cannot hide from Ramjet’s reckless abandon.'' #* 100% chance to Stun the opponent for 4 seconds. (And Ramjet himself for 1 second) #* 100% chance to inflict a 25% Resistance Debuff for 30 seconds. ===Synergy Bonuses=== *[[File:Synergy-incoming.jpg|20px]][[File:Synergy-outgoing.jpg|20px]] '''Allies – '''[[Soundwave]], [[Bludgeon]], [[Starscream]] - +2~3~8% Armor *[[File:Synergy-incoming.jpg|20px]][[File:Synergy-outgoing.jpg|20px]] '''Enemies''' – [[Windblade]], [[Jetfire]] - +2~3~8% Attack Rating *'''Unstoppable Force''' – [[Motormaster]] ** [[File:Synergy-incoming.jpg|20px]] 15~20~30% chance Ramjet gains Unstoppable for 3 seconds after the last hit of a special attack. ** [[File:Synergy-outgoing.jpg|20px]] 15~20~30% chance Motormaster stuns his opponent for 2.5 seconds after the last hit of a special attack. *[[File:Synergy-incoming.jpg|20px]] '''Starscream's Seekers''' - [[Starscream]] - 5~8~15% Damage and 20~30~75% Armor Piercing for all Decepticon Ranged Attacks. *[[File:Synergy-incoming.jpg|20px]][[File:Synergy-outgoing.jpg|20px]]  '''Enforcers''' - Motormaster, [[Kickback]] - Debuffs last 20~25~40% longer and cannot be Purified. *[[File:Synergy-outgoing.jpg|20px]] '''Leadership''' (5-Star) - +10% Special Damage. ==Strategy== ===Player=== Ramjet is the master of stuns and he stuns so much he even stuns himself in his 3rd special attack unless he has a lot of momentum. It's a good idea to use regular melee combos to build up power. When the time presents itself, use your heavy attacks. Know that you aren't always invincible when you're heavy attacking; You might be unstoppable but you're not invincible. Build up enough special damage to immediately start attacking the enemy after your special 3. Usually, building four special buffs will make sure you recover from the self-stun immediately. Ramjet's Special 2 was notorious for whiffing, his first thruster-stun hit can fall short and miss. This happens most often when the Special is immediately launched right after a melee combo. Wait for a split half-second at the last hit of a combo before firing for the hit to connect. ===Opponent=== Ranged combat will be your friend. Stay at range to keep away from Ramjet's deadly heavy attacks. Bots who possess a heavy ranged attack will help you out very well and in the other hand, Melee bots like Brawlers will struggle in defeating Ramjet as they get rammed instantly over and over again. Scouts bots too won't be able to activate Evasion once they are Stunned. ===Strong Match-ups=== * '''[[Scout]]'''s bots mostly rely on Evades, something Ramjet will stop these occurrences with Stuns and make these evasion do nothing. *'''[[Optimus Prime|Optimus Prime (GS)]]''' - Optimus Prime will attempt to use his Heavy Attack to Roll Out, but Ramjet will always win when it comes to vehicle-on-vehicle collision. * [[Megatron (ROTF)|'''Megatron (ROTF)''']] - Like all damaging debuffs, burns will cut right through the Demolition King’s natural armor. Stunning the big fella is also a good way to ensure his Unstoppable triggers are spent in a daze even though he utilises ranged attacks. * [[Jazz|'''Jazz''']]''' - '''Autobot Jazz enjoys seeing his opponents Stunned, but Ramjet can ignore Stuns when he has a lot of Momentum and of course stun him in return. Well that’s not fair! ===Weak Match-ups=== * '''[[Megatronus]]''' - When Ramjet stuns the lord of the demolitions, the relic of immortality will contain any damage that was hit, the relic of obedience will prevent Ramjet from gaining Momentums and being Unstoppable during his Heavy attack and the relic of preservation will prevent him from the damage of the burn debuffs. * '''[[Grimlock]]''' - Grimlock will easily Purify Ramjet’s Burn Debuffs leaving the master of stuns without one of his most powerful tools. * '''[[Rhinox]]''' - Rhinox’s Shielding will be highly effective against Ramjet’s powerful Special Attacks. Additionally the Rhino-bot is resistant to Burn damage. * Any bot who utilizes Ranged attacks will be your friend. * '''[[Starscream]]''' - Despite the class advantage, the coward's Null Ray will tear through his comrade's special buffs and he deals his attacks mostly on ranged avoiding the heavy attacks. Just watch out for close-quarter combat. * '''[[Kickback]] - '''Opponents who are T-Clogged will face the consequences when using a heavy attack while T-Clogged but Ramjet loves to use heavy attacks. *'''[[Rodimus Prime]]''' - Despite the class advantage, Ramjet can no longer Stun Rodimus when he's below 40% max health. ===Recommended Modules=== The master of stuns will effectively defends your Base with these Modules. * '''[[Strange Refractor]] and [[Paralyzer]]''' will mesh well with Ramjet’s up-close fighting style, turning the master of Stuns into an absolute wrecking ball against his helpless opponents. * '''[[Security Module]]''' will enhance Ramjet’s natural toughness, turning him into a tank….that flies like Grindor. * '''[[Transwarp Cell]]''' will boost the chance Ramjet uses his Heavy Attack, since he is unstoppable during Heavy Attacks  that is something you’ll want him to do often. * '''[[Exo-Filter]] - '''Ramming with ''Heavy Attacks makes Ramjet more ''Unstoppable, burnin' through the sky, yeah! * '''[[Superconductor 1000]]''' - Ramjet's Special I is already hard to dodge, make that chance second to none. ==Obtainment== *Ramjet Arenas **Flight Risk (3-Star) **Kinetic Killer (4-Star) *Airhead Crystal *December Daily Calendar *Bot Crystals (Added 12/12/2017) *Throwback Week (2-Star) *Dynamic Duo Crystal *February 2020 ==Gallery== Ramjet Icon.jpg Ramjet portrait.png|First version of portrait Ramjet Icon v2.jpg|Updated Icon Ramjet portrait v2.png|Old 2.0 portrait NOT FOUND Ramjet Icon v3.jpg Ramjet portrait v3.png Ramjet2.png
== Updates == * Heavy Stuns were initially a 75~90% chance for 2.5 seconds, before it was changed to guaranteed for 3 seconds. * Special 1's Burn was at a 20~22~25~30~35% attack rate over 5 seconds, before scaling up to 30~40% and an extra second. * Special 2's Burn was rank-scaled from a 80~100% chance and a 40~60% attack rate for 4 seconds, before it was changed to guaranteed and a 50~70% Attack rate over 6 seconds. And an extra .5 seconds of Stun to 3. * Special 3's Stun was rank-scaled from a 80~100% chance for 2 seconds, before it was changed to guaranteed for 4 seconds. * Signature Momentum Special bonus buff chance was scaled from 3% to 5%. == Trivia == * Ramjet's design is based on his Universe 2008 ''Classics'' remold toy. * Ramjet is like Dirge and Thrust a Conehead, a Group of Seekers. ==External Links== [[Category:Bots]] [[Category:Decepticons]] [[Category:Generation 1]] [[Category:Generation 1 Decepticons]] [[Category:Demolitions]] [[Category:G1]] [[Category:1-Star Bots]] [[Category:2-Star Bots]] [[Category:3-Star Bots]] [[Category:4-Star Bots]] [[Category:5-Star Bots]]
